units.source_text: 大竹七段劝我说，这是个好机会，也请东乡检查一下身体吧。

en.t: Otake seventh dan urged me, saying that this was a good opportunity, and that I should have Togo examine my body as well.

units.source_text: 大竹显得又亲切又热心，我一到他的房间，东乡就用手掌按摩我的身体。

en.t: Otake seemed both kind and eager to help, and as soon as I arrived in his room, Togo massaged my body with his palms.
